# Indikator 11

Indikator 11 is a quality indicator in the Danish [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-databasen]], the national clinical database that tracks ADHD diagnosis and treatment. It measures the share of treatment courses ("behandlingsforløb") among adult patients (18 years and older) in which the patient is in pharmacological treatment with ADHD medication [^src2]. Specifically, it asks whether the patient has started medical treatment no later than 120 days after the beginning of a "pakkeforløb" (structured treatment package) [^src2].

The indicator is new: it was introduced as part of a 2024 expansion of the ADHD-databasen to cover adult patients for the first time, alongside Indikators 8, 9 and 10, which also concern adults with an ADHD diagnosis [^src1]. Because this is the first time the adult population and these indicators have been reported, the results for Indikator 11 are presented without historical data or trend graphs [^src1][^src2].

For the reporting period 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025, national fulfilment of Indikator 11 was measured at 70 (68–72) percent [^src1]. Unlike most other indicators in the ADHD-databasen, Indikator 11 carries no formal development target ("udviklingsmål") [^src2]. The database's methodology notes describe it as an "exploratory" indicator, similar in nature to the corresponding indicator used for the child and adolescent population, meaning there is no defined goal for how many patients should be placed in medication [^src2]. Its value, according to the source, lies instead in being read alongside indicators on psychoeducation, psychotherapy, and assessment of social support needs [^src2].

Data quality for the indicator is described as good, since it draws on Denmark's national prescription statistics database ("lægemiddelstatistikdatabasen"), where all redeemed prescriptions are automatically registered [^src2]. Despite this, regional results varied sharply: Region Hovedstaden reported only 37% fulfilment, which the steering group ("styregruppen") attributed mainly to registration difficulties rather than genuine differences in clinical practice [^src3]. By contrast, the broader chunk context notes Region Nordjylland's result at 85%, underscoring the regional disparity behind the 68–72% national confidence interval [^src1][^src3].

The future of Indikator 11 as a formal quality indicator is under discussion. The steering group has raised whether it should instead be moved out of the indicator set and included as supplementary material in the annual report, with a final decision expected at the group's next meeting [^src2].

## Claims

**Observation**
- Indikator 8-11 vedrører voksne med en ADHD-diagnose. Det er første gang denne patientgruppe og tilhørende indikatorer og resultaterne præsenteres derfor uden historik [^src1] (indikator-8, indikator-9, indikator-10, indikator-11) — Page 8
- Denne indikator vedrører voksne (18+ år) og da det er første gang indikatoren opgøres præsenteres den uden historik og trendgraf [^src1] (indikator-11) — Page 57
- Som det er gældende i børne- og ungepopulation i ADHD-databasen er der også hos voksne tale om en såkaldt eksplorativ indikator uden mål for hvor mange, der skal sættes i medicinsk behandling [^src1] (indikator-11) — Page 57
- Imidlertid kan indikatoren bidrage med vigtig information når den holdes op mod indikatorerne om psykoedukation, psykoterapi og vurdering af sociale støttebehov [^src1] (indikator-11) — Page 57

**Performance**
- Indikator 11 opfyldelse var 70 (68-72) % for perioden 01.04.2024 - 31.03.2025 [^src1] (indikator-11) — Page 10
- Region Hovedstaden ligger på 37% for indikator 11 [^src1] (region-hovedstaden, indikator-11) — Page 68

**Clinical-standard**
- Indikator 11 drejer sig om hvorvidt patienten er i medicinsk behandling senest 120 dage efter starten af pakkeforløb [^src1] (indikator-11) — Page 57
- Der er intet udviklingsmål for denne indikator [^src1] (indikator-11) — Page 57

**Methodology**
- Indikatoren er baseret på data fra lægemiddelstatistikdatabasen. Datakompletheden er således god, da alle indløste recepter automatisk registreres i databasen [^src1] (indikator-11) — Page 57

**Decision**
- Det diskuteres om indikatoren bør udgå som indikator og oplysningerne i stedet skal placeres som supplerende materiale i rapporten [^src1] (indikator-11) — Page 57
- Styregruppen vil ved næste styregruppemøde tage endelig stilling til om denne indikator i stedet skal indgå som supplerende materiale [^src1] (indikator-11) — Page 57
